question:
The given graph provides details of the number of girl students and boy students in four sections of class X of a school. Study the graph and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba343f6d847dab10a083f56c57133e5060c49b8ce646c741abe66358b117b6e3.png] 

Which section has the maximum percentage of girls of the total students in that section?
solution:
**Calculation**

The maximum percentage of girls of the total students is in 10C which is 26.

**The answer is 10C.**
